Strong eye silhouette readable at thumbnail size, sophisticated detail up close. Only text is a small accurately spelled "awake.vc" signature bottom left, comfortably inset; no artist signature. This is an original composition, not reproduction of an existing artwork. RENÉ MAGRITTE inspired conceptual surrealism. Immaculate smooth edges, calm daylight, believable objects in a quietly impossible relationship, restrained palette of sky blue, pale stone, charcoal and luminous gold. A monumental freestanding architectural eye-shaped aperture hangs in a blue sky above a tranquil sea; the view THROUGH the eye is a clear daytime miniature city, but its reflection in the sea reveals the same city as a starry interconnected network. The iris is a golden sun with a tiny ordinary doorway in its center, a small human builder approaching it along a slender stone causeway. White clouds pass both in front of and behind the eye with spatial paradox. A few discreet pearl-like points and threadlike connections suggest shared intelligence. Spare, lucid, witty, mysterious, substantial negative space. Avoid ornate high fantasy; conceptual surprise is the focus.
